profile.headline: SWE @ Google  | CS @ Brown University
profile.summary:
👋 A Computer Science student at Brown University deeply passionate about software development, particularly in the exciting realm of Artificial Intelligence (AI).
🤖 My passion lies in exploring the fascinating intersection of computer science and AI, where I am constantly intrigued by the potential of AI technologies to transform industries and solve complex problems.
💻 As a motivated learner, I'm fascinated by the power of code to bring ideas to life and drive meaningful change. Whether it's crafting elegant algorithms, architecting scalable systems, or debugging intricate issues, I thrive on the challenge and creativity inherent in software development.
🚀 As I continue my academic journey, I am eager to apply my skills and knowledge to real-world projects. I am particularly interested in opportunities that allow me to work with cutting-edge technologies and collaborate with talented teams to create impactful software solutions.

Let's connect and explore how I can contribute to your next software development endeavor!

positions.title: Software Engineer, Google Cloud AI
positions.description: Skills: Cloud Computing · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Python (Programming Language) · MaaS (Model-as-a-Service) · Anthropic's Claude models · Mash (Google's analytical query framework)

positions.title: Software Engineer, Corporate Services Technology
positions.description:
• Engineered REST API integrations linking on-prem Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) with Oracle Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) SaaS, automating PL/SQL-driven data transfers and streamlining financial workflows.
• Spearheaded server migration from RHEL 7 to RHEL 8, enhancing system security, performance, and compliance with Fidelity Technology Lifecycle Management (TLM) standards.
• Conducted end-to-end integration testing and debugging of Fidelity EPM applications, creating structured troubleshooting documentation for long-term monitoring and issue resolution.
• Delivered scalable solutions using Groovy scripting, Oracle SQL, PL/SQL, SQL Developer, and Agile (JIRA), collaborating cross-functionally to improve data accuracy and system reliability.
positions.insights: Skills: REST API Development & Integration · Oracle SQL · PL/SQL · Oracle SQL Developer · Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) · Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) · Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) Suite · Groovy Scripting · Apache Groovy · Integration Testing · Debugging & Troubleshooting · Agile Methodologies · Jira · Technical Documentation

positions.title: Data Engineer Co-op, Asset Management
positions.description:
•	Responsible for collecting, integrating, and managing data from various sources of asset management databases to ensure consistency and accuracy across the asset management platform.
•	Design and maintain efficient, secure, and scalable data storage solutions, optimize ETL processes, and develop insightful dashboards and reports for asset performance and operational efficiency.
•	Collaborate with engineers, analysts, and other stakeholders to understand data needs, implement data security measures, and support innovative asset management initiatives to enhance performance and reduce costs.
•	Support the development and revision of documents and procedures that support asset management processes within the organization.
•	Support internal self-assessments of asset information to ensure the accuracy of baselined information is maintained. 
•	Develop reports, prepare presentations, write procedures and perform other activities as needed.

positions.title: Engineering Assistant
positions.description:
•	Assisted in the design and development of a water flume for the School of Engineering, enhancing research capabilities in energy harvesting and bio-inspired engineering.
•	Collaborated with faculty and researchers to ensure the flume met all specifications for current and future research projects.

positions.title: Developer (Hack@Brown)
positions.description:
• Participated in Hack@Brown 2024 to design and develop the front-end component of an AI-Generator Completer, utilized OpenAI APIs to call ChatGPT, showcasing proficiency in user interface design, HTML/CSS, MongoDB, and web development. 
• Collaborated with teammates to innovate and deliver a functional solution within the constraints of a hackathon environment.

positions.title: Research Analyst (Yale Young Scholars Program in Biostatistics & Clinical Research)
positions.description:
• Utilized R programming language to perform advanced statistical analysis on collected data. Applied inferential/descriptive statistical methods to draw insights and identify trends in medical research data. 
• Created visually engaging and informative data visualizations, including graphs, charts, and tables, using R packages such as ggplot2. Transformed complex data into actionable insights for research reports and final presentation. 
• Actively engaged in learning and developing skills related to data analysis, statistical modelling, and R programming through workshops, training, and self-directed learning.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Collaborated with the ServiceNow development team to customize the user interface (UI) components of the ServiceNow platform. Developed responsive and dynamic UI elements to improve user experience and streamline access to IT services. 
• Conducted testing of ServiceNow updates, enhancements, and customizations to ensure proper functionality, data accuracy, and a positive user experience. Provided user support by responding to inquiries and assisting employees with ServiceNow-related questions.
